name: incus-storage-pool
description: An incus storage pool, so the `dir` default — no reflinks, no quotas — is a choice a declaration records rather than an accident of whatever the daemon had
instructions: Host-converging module: creates a storage pool on the local incus daemon and installs the apt package that makes incus advertise the driver. `dir | btrfs | zfs | lvm`. `dir` writes guest disks straight onto the host filesystem: fastest for VM images, and it can express neither a copy-on-write clone nor a per-guest quota. Needs incus and passwordless sudo.
